name: Bramblescar
summary: Across the southern Barrens, Razormane warriors at Bramblescar fight the Bristleback across the Gold Road. Thick brambles guard their settlement.

sections.title: A Thorned Redoubt
sections.body: In the southern Barrens, sharp briars form a redoubt for the Razormane quilboar. Their thick thorns keep casual wanderers away. The tribe guards its territory fiercely and treats outsiders as intruders on land blessed by their ancient boar gods.

sections.title: Tribal Blood Feud
sections.body: Across the Gold Road from Bramblescar lies Agama'gor, the Bristleback encampment. The two tribes wage an unrelenting war for dominion over the southern Barrens. Razormane warriors fight Horde travelers along the highway and turn back Bristleback raiding parties. So the tribes remain in constant, violent conflict.

faq.answer: The Razormane tribe of quilboar lives in Bramblescar. They defend their thorn-choked encampment from rival quilboar and passing travelers.

faq.q: Why are the quilboar here fighting each other?
faq.answer: The Razormane of Bramblescar and the Bristleback at Agama'gor are bitter enemies. They fight for control of the southern Barrens.
Bramblescar lies in the southern plains of the Barrens, just east of the main Gold Road and across from Agama'gor.

faq.q: Are the quilboar here hostile to the Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. The Razormane see the Horde as invaders on their sacred tribal lands. They attack travelers who come too close.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you need the Gold Road clear of raids from Bramblescar to travel safely between Crossroads, Camp Taurajo, and the southern frontier.
